headlines.title: Everyone Is Talking About Ferritin Levels. How Much Does It Really Matter for Your Health?
headlines.description: A hemotologist explains what ferritin is and how it can impact your iron levels. Learn how to check your ferritin and how your doctor might interpret your results.

headlines.title: More Than 122,000 Cases of Gatorade Recalled Across the Country: What to Know
headlines.description: More than 122,000 cases of Gatorade have been recalled in 37 states for undeclared food dyes, according to a notice by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

headlines.title: Are Flu and Cold Symptoms Worse for Men or Women?
headlines.description: There may actually be some biological truth to the so-called “man cold.” NBC medical contributors Dr. Natalie Azar and Dr. Akshay Syal join TODAY to break down how men and women may experience virus symptoms differently and share common treatments that work for everyone.

headlines.title: Brooke Eby, Who Chronicled Life With ALS on TikTok, Dies at 37
headlines.description: Brooke Eby, a TikTok star who documented her battle with ALS with courage, openness and humor, has died at the age of 37. Eby, who received the diagnosis just four years ago, posted videos on social media, determined to share every aspect of her journey.

headlines.title: Researcher at Russian Lab Dies After Potential Plague Exposure
headlines.description: A researcher at a lab in Siberia has died after potentially being exposed to pneumonic plague, according to reports. Now, almost 200 people are reportedly under quarantine in the wake of that death, with the incident putting health officials around the world on alert. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Cyklar products look great on the bathroom counter, but are they actually effective? We tested them to find out
headlines.description: Cyklar is viral on social media, but is it worth the hefty price tag? Our NBC Selected editors tested its most popular products to find out what’s worth buying and skipping.

headlines.description: Savannah Guthrie mourned the death of social media influencer Brooke Eby, revealing Oct. 5 on TODAY that she died from ALS on Oct. 1 at the age of 37.

headlines.title: Over 160,000 Pounds of Meat Recalled Due to Lack of Inspection, Receives Highest Risk Level From USDA
headlines.description: Approximately 167,639 pounds of raw pork, beef and goat products have been recalled for being produced without inspection. They were also falsely labeled.
